rationale: C19 provides a close structural and linguistic template: prior familiarity with the reasons for departure, reluctant acceptance effective at the close of business, an extended review of distinguished public service, an expectation of future advice, and a concluding expression of gratitude. C20 and C12 also contain strong resignation-letter formulas, but C19 parallels more of the child's full progression and closing substance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In acquiescing in your wishes I am moved by circumstances with which I have long been familiar. Reluctantly, therefore, and with deep regret I accept, effective at the close of business...the resignation which you tender
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am therefore fully cognizant of the considerations which prompt your desire to relinquish your duties...I accept your resignation effective at the close of business...Although I take this action reluctantly
shared_material.explanation: Both open by acknowledging previously known reasons for leaving and then reluctantly accept the resignation using the same effective-at-close-of-business formula.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It would be difficult to overstate the value of the services which you have rendered your country...Through six years of public service...you have devoted your talents and superb abilities exclusively to your country's welfare.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your service to your country covering a period of almost nine years...has been as varied as it has been distinguished.
shared_material.explanation: Both follow acceptance with an extended retrospective appraisal of the official's years of distinguished national service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: My regret at your departure is tempered by the knowledge that you are to remain in Washington and the assurance that I can call upon you as occasion requires.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I do so with less misgiving because I know you will be standing by to give advice and counsel
shared_material.explanation: The same mitigating idea appears near the close: regret over departure is eased by the departing official's continued availability for advice.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For all that you have given we owe you a debt impossible to pay...every assurance of my personal gratitude and appreciation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For all that you have done in your country's behalf...I tender you heartfelt assurance of my gratitude and appreciation.
shared_material.explanation: The concluding gratitude language is closely parallel and occupies the same structural position.
